result.title: TIBECG: Temporal Information Bottleneck for Lead-Specific Demographic Privacy in ECG Waveform Release
result.comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Corresponding author: Tsai-Min Chen
result.summary: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies by lead. Lower latent Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence does not reliably rank residual sex leakage at a fixed length. These findings support lead-specific evaluation of waveform processing, not validated consumer deployment or expert-readable reconstruction. When the waveform-input diagnostic classifier is hosted as part of a proprietary cloud service rather than deployed on the device, waveform transmission is required to obtain its scores.

AI.brief_summary: 论文评估一种可在单导联 ECG 波形上变化 latent 长度的时序信息瓶颈处理器，衡量其在保留诊断宏 F1 的同时抑制年龄/性别推断的表现，并与降采样等传统处理方式作比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 可变 latent 长度下的「效用—泄漏」权衡，以及「固定长度时 latent KL 无法可靠排序残留泄漏」这一负结果，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、以及 latent 相似度指标能否反映内容；但研究对象是心电时间序列，迁移线索较远，需较多核查。
